page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard1.8 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Standard instance family. The server provides 16 vCPUs derived from 8 dedicated physical cores running at a base clock frequency of 2.3 GHz, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2699 v3 processor on the x86_64 architecture with 2 threads per core. System memory is sized at 56.0 GB, which yields an allocation of 3.5 GB per vCPU.

Hardware accelerators are absent, with 0 GPUs provisioned on this instance. The server includes no onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on network-attached block or object storage for OS images and operational data persistence. Network access includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Because the hardware uses dedicated CPU allocation rather than shared or burstable cores, processing capacity is consistent.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the resource ratio delivers balanced compute and memory capacity for sustained multi-threaded workloads without premium accelerator overhead. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard1.8 is suited for general enterprise application hosting, relational databases with external storage, CI/CD runners, background batch processing, and mid-tier web serving pipelines.
